reviews.classification: full fit/palette content review; exact consumer closures distinguished from broader source and policy gaps
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all324 original lines:29dossier method/status, K1–K11, ranked actions/stale-pointer table, all194per-source rows and O1–O5. CountsD33/P79/O54/N22/S2/X4 describe October22 grep/source-report fit, not native proof, fresh decomp inspection or current installation. Every row was read; a current seam path existing does not prove its function export/consumer/state or qualify the original game's behavior. No raw extraction, upstream binary, source book or current runtime was inspected.

F2: The actually read later K1/K2 checkpoint/B494 and B572 K3 review supersede this early all-open/absent-manual diagnosis at exact consumer scope. K1 required an optional persisted mixture lastCompletion because acquisition-only/cleared-job history lacked consumed inputs; workPlan lastResult instead derives from the audience-scoped100entrylog. Missing/evicted history means none recorded, not never happened or reconstructed consumption. K2 steep/boil uses the same selected real stock with separate tokens, held vessel inputs and native blocked-key disposition; one commit stales the other. It closes two-product comparison, not Potionomics/Stardew sell/native-recipe destinations. Borrowed-key-spend repair and completed-versus-next-batch input identity are real reported consumer fixes, not a generic reservation engine.

F3: K3's later Rat-step Book reading/manual versus guide reaches common understanding and preserves native practice; it does not deliver Eda's single-earned-choice resin alternative or damaged page-level manuals. Current SLR carrier/learning laws permit stronger actual means to grant execution; no blanket teacher/book limitation. Existing K1/K2 six ready viewport cases differ from1920persistence and unproven1536/21reload launcher; actual smaller text roles persist. Later source/build/test/committed evidence belongs to those receipts, not fresh proof by this refit review or all194rows.

F4: Preserve remaining K4 fallible knowledge/revision versus monotonic stage, K5 actual office/wage/arrears/notice/kin-agreement/jurisdiction, K6 lasting practice quality versus throughput, K7 item/part/process wear, K8 real salvage eligibility, K9 dated cohort/assessment, K10 farming/fishing/delegation and K11 actor goals/support/abort as distinct consumer questions. Shared clusters navigate common seams but one build cannot automatically close every row's different retained terms/source/reader. Current W1–W4 owners retain their later progress, not a parallel lane from the old table. No synthetic global mood, universal pressure/injury, compulsory school/calendar, copy of stock or all-world rate conversion is introduced.

F5: The source tables preserve working native/everyday/care/mixture/material/home/skill/chronicle/quest/people functions while naming missing joins. A menu/reference/read-only projector is not completed learning or action; a timer/condition/known route is not current support/knowledge/permission. Compiler validation of239tokens is navigation evidence, not a whole-callgraph/current-API audit. Top-level not-found and line drift limits remain explicit, including corrected Disco pointers. Ward/lock/page/trait/favor/effect families are optional source applications, not new mandatory owners merely because a row said N. Current AD38/AD51 preserves local laws/exception mechanisms and a justified first shared seam; current PROJECT owns build order.

F6: O1–O5 targeted Dwarf Fortress/Qud/Taiwu/Zomboid/Songs of Syx/Stoneshard routes are dated suggestions, not live entitlement/install/license/download/agent instructions. Existing extracted/read data should be consulted when a selected exact question needs it; empty Cpp2IL bodies are navigation, not executable mechanic proof. No new Ghidra/ILSpy/decomp, acquisition, purchase, source wave, runtime, migration, worker, deletion, commit or push.

reviews.classification: full fit/palette content review; exact consumer closures distinguished from broader source and policy gaps
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all152 original lines: R1–R6/F1–F5/L1–L5/C1–C4/G1–G4/B1–B6/D1–D4/E1–E5/T1–T5/process note and later U1–U4. This is a six-source proposal palette with Knight/Second Life Ranker expressly interim; no private dossier, novel chapter or game source was reread here. Source claim, reader theory, metaphor and original adaptation stay attributed. Public franchise plot evidence is not changed sealed world truth. Current continuation/entry/time/source owners govern actual use.

F2: Trigger/anchor/carry/cost/witness/exit is a useful set of questions, not proof one six-field engine covers every source or a selected universal reset schema. Supplied first-milestone/single-prestige framing is retired by current PROJECT; prestige, new life, body recovery, replay, branch creation, real rewind, diary-derived knowledge and a claimed false reset are different operations. A source's single earned regression remains its qualified case; a costly recipe is not proof a second reset is possible, and no fictional once-ever cap should be invented where actual means allow more. Neither no reset nor an afterlife hypothesis qualifies from a title alone.

F3: Preserve specific foreknowledge carriers and staleness causes without imposing automatic decay/memory loss on every world. Personal lived memory, dreams/testimony/diary/copied memory differ, as do occurrence versus remembered/read knowledge. Changed causes can invalidate expectation; writing may support retention but does not make every remembered event true. Looper population/mentor/inherited loop/detection/false cheat are distinct proposed character functions; the every-book-other-loopers sentence and unfinished-reader details are not newly source-certified. A stuck overseer is not a compulsory punishment for idle play.

F4: Actual source-supported trauma, paid sacrifice, lived-time cooldown, aging, hunger, affection, belief or refusal can matter through local readers, not universal farming-control or balance taxes under AD22/AD38. Better powers may remove a cost rather than trigger replacement busywork. Mutual shared rewind/remembered personal obligation differs from another person's present consent/debt, and source-specific bonds surviving without memories are not all-world inheritance. Real retention/cargo/external claims/clock/source policy must be explicit. Death destination/ending/tower roles remain separate setting possibilities; a floor/scene label does not grant ownership, system authority or a free world.

F5: The process note correctly preserves three scout premise corrections; B576 retains the stale Absolute Regression loop-meter cell as superseded scout text. U1–U4 are later README/survey-level comparisons, explicitly unread source where stated: world persistence versus person reset, failure retaining discovery, located purchased resurrection and tree/life/eternal scopes are conditional ideas, not native deliveries or a required rename. Current continuation CA1–CA7/CA13/CA14/reciprocal/intentional-loop direction already answers selected access questions; this older palette does not reopen them. Technical retry of one operation differs from a deliberate fresh supported loop. Human taste is optional under AD42, no universal new death/loss/offline policy or worker is selected. No new source reading/acquisition, runtime, private save, migration, deletion, commit or push.
